usedFor: Memberful holds members and orders, and HubSpot keeps the contact that “Update Contact” changes after “When a member is updated”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a member is updated” in Memberful, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It passes the updated member record along, so the HubSpot contact can match the member.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in HubSpot finds the contact by its email, so the member must already exist there.
